summary.text: Demi Palecek is the Democratic candidate for the Illinois House of Representatives, District 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces Republican Terry Le for a seat with no incumbent.
A communications consultant and National Guard member, she is president of the 46th Ward Democrats.

paragraphs.text: Demi Palecek was born in Edwardsville, Illinois, and earned a high school diploma from Edwardsville High School and a bachelor's degree from Columbia College Chicago in 2020.
She has served in the U.S. Army National Guard since 2011, and her career experience includes working as a communications consultant.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she began working at 15, including in the service industry, and serves in the Guard as an Equal Opportunity advocate.
Palecek ran in the 2023 nonpartisan general election for Chicago Police District Council, District 19, receiving 12.1 percent of the vote.
She advanced from the March 17, 2026 Democratic primary for the Illinois House.

In her survey, she said she is running a grassroots campaign without corporate PAC money and named fully funded transit, affordable housing, medical care access and immigrant protections among her priorities.
